name: DEEP-PSMA (PSMA + FDG PET/CT, mCRPC)
what: DEEP-PSMA, PSMA and FDG PET/CT of 100 patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, Zenodo record 15281784; tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: 200 CTs in the release, of which the data platform counts 53, since about half the attenuation CTs are thicker than 3 mm, about 24.07 GB in the catalogue (NIfTI)
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder

segmentations.masks: not recorded: the fetch took every case archive, so any masks the release ships are inside them
vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh zenodo --collection deep_psma --record 15281784 --include '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}\.zip$', submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and, by the manifest's note, 5 zips by md5 and 200 CT.nii.gz to verify.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid deep_psma; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="deep_psma",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
